stories.title: SEC committee schedules an IPO and crowdfunding discussion
stories.classification: Official meeting announcement · Not a rule change
stories.dek: The SEC announced an October 27 public meeting of its Small Business Capital Formation Advisory Committee. The agenda covers IPO modernization and potential changes to Regulation Crowdfunding; the meeting is scheduled to begin at 10 a.m. and be streamed on SEC.gov.
paragraphs: The SEC announced an October 27 public meeting of its Small Business Capital Formation Advisory Committee. The agenda covers IPO modernization and potential changes to Regulation Crowdfunding; the meeting is scheduled to begin at 10 a.m. and be streamed on SEC.gov.
An advisory discussion does not enact a regulatory change. Follow the agency’s agenda and later recommendations separately from any future Commission rulemaking.
stories.takeaway: An advisory discussion does not enact a regulatory change. Follow the agency’s agenda and later recommendations separately from any future Commission rulemaking.
